sourcePin.heading: ### RIVER RCA — LATEST-STUDY LIVE iOS FAILURE (2026-08-25)

rows.exactPrompt: When was the last time I studied?
rows.syntheticReproduction: Seed owner-scoped practice history with a known latest local date, ask the repository-authorized exact question, and compare the answer with the authoritative aggregate.
rows.unacceptableOutcome: Coach selected a model teaching path instead of the history read, then fabricated, refused, or returned no answer.
rows.expectedBehavior: A deterministic pre-model owner-scoped practice-history read returns the correct local date and days-since value with evidence, zero model calls, and no plan capability or write.
evidenceGaps: The authoritative failed turn trace is not attached to this inventory. Next evidence source: the content-free 2026-08-25 iOS turn trace containing route, stop reason, capability calls, and persisted message count.

rows.syntheticReproduction: After Coach answers the latest-study question, dispute the date by stating that practice occurred yesterday.
rows.unacceptableOutcome: Coach reused an unsupported cached answer, failed to acknowledge the correction, or diverted the dispute to a plan fallback.
rows.expectedBehavior: Coach re-reads authoritative owner-scoped history, compares it with the prior claim, acknowledges and corrects changed evidence, or states the records available without inventing a reconciliation.
evidenceGaps: Repository artifacts contain two correction phrasings, but the historical exact learner text is not established. Next evidence source: owner-authorized authoritative turn export for the disputed answer.

rows.syntheticReproduction: Open Coach in a narrow mobile viewport over interactive app content and inspect visual separation, dialog semantics, focus, and underlying-app interactivity.
rows.unacceptableOutcome: The panel blended into app content, lacked a scrim and modal semantics, and left underlying content interactive.
rows.expectedBehavior: A distinct scrim is visible; the panel exposes dialog and modal semantics; the underlying app is inert; focus and dismissal remain usable.
evidenceGaps: The original screenshot and accessibility-tree capture are absent. Next evidence source: Captain-authorized attachment hash plus the matching viewport-sized accessibility snapshot.
